title: Investor's representative built a 1 millinewton thruster in his garage

tellings.quote: What do you mean? I already built one in my garage.

plain: Charles Buhler, an engineer who appears on an episode about NASA work on new kinds of propulsion, tells Michels about an investor's representative who said he had already built a working thruster in his garage. The thruster is said to give about one millinewton of push, a tiny but measurable force. Buhler quotes the man's reply as 'What do you mean? I already built one in my garage,' which would mean such devices are being built outside big laboratories.
